cp23:1.1: Punāparaṃ yadā homi Kāsirājassa atrajo ayogharamhi saṃvaḍḍho nāmen' āsi Ayogharo. || ||
cp23:2.1: Dukkhena jīvito laddho sampīḷe patiposito ajj' eva putta paṭipajja kevalaṃ vasudhaṃ imaṃ. || ||
cp23:3.1: Saraṭṭhakaṃ sanigamaṃ sajanaṃ vanditvā khattiyaṃ añjaliṃ paggahetvāna idaṃ vacanam-abraviṃ: || ||
cp23:4.1: Ye keci mahiyā sattā hīna-m-ukkaṭṭhamajjhimā nirārakkhā sake gehe vaḍḍhanti sakañātibhi. || ||
cp23:5.1: Idaṃ loke uttariyaṃ sampīḷe mama posanaṃ ayogharamhi saṃvaḍḍho appabhe candasūriye. || ||
cp23:6.1: Pūtikuṇapasampuṇṇā muccitvā mātu kucchito tato ghoratare dukkhe puna pakkhitt' ayoghare. || ||
cp23:7.1: Yadi' haṃ tādisaṃ patvā dukkhaṃ paramadāruṇaṃ rajjesu yadi rajjāmi pāpānaṃ uttamo siyaṃ. || ||
cp23:8.1: Ukkaṇṭhito' mhi kāyena rajjena' mhi anatthiko nibbutiṃ pariyesissaṃ yattha maṃ Maccu na maddiye. || ||
cp23:9.1: Ev' āhaṃ cintayitvāna viravantaṃ mahājanaṃ nāgo va bandhanaṃ chetvā pāvisiṃ kānanaṃ vanaṃ. || ||
cp23:10.1: Mātā pitā na me dessā na pi me dessaṃ mahāyasaṃ sabbaññutaṃ piyaṃ mayhaṃ tasmā rajjaṃ pariccajin-ti. || ||
